protocol: Closed equal-density D2Q9 flat slits: conservative relative-phase transfer, center/tangent/halfway/ghost color gradients, signed pressure and four-duration holds. H16/32/48 use joint grid/sharp-interface scaling.
scope: Neutral complete transient and fixed-point controls; bounded static nonneutral pressure comparison. No general wetting, open-reservoir, curved-wall, thermodynamic or trapping claim.

independent.protocol: Independent D2Q9 scalar specular-forward/relative-flux control; random mixed fraction and nonuniform hydrodynamic equilibria; no flow solver.
independent.scope: Zero-flow neutral recurrence and algebraic face identities; nonneutral hydrodynamic accuracy is not implied.

ghost_gradient_audit.note: Outgoing-state gradients only; not a comparison with incoming-state velocities.

contracts.scope: Flat D2Q9 transient/fixed-point identities, pure-phase no-slip, short nonneutral replay; not a wetting accuracy result.
